main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Processes a series of test cases by reading integer and long-integer inputs, deriving M and N arrays, computing suffix-length arrays longm and longn, and printing the maximum value and its occurrence count for each case." main]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> return_value </REF>: int "Always returns 0 after all test cases are processed."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read the first integer from standard input using scanf("%d", &ntests) into ntests, ignoring the returned status. RESULT ntests]
            [COMMAND For each test case with test running from 1 to ntests inclusive, read an integer s from standard input using scanf("%d", &s) into s. If ntests is less than 1, the loop body is not executed. RESULT s]
            [COMMAND Within the same test-case iteration, for each index i from 0 to s-1 inclusive, read three long integers into D[i], A[i], and B[i] using scanf("%li %li %li", D+i, A+i, B+i); then set M[i] = D[i] + A[i] and N[i] = D[i] - B[i]. RESULT D_A_B_M_N_arrays]
            [COMMAND Set longm[0] = 1 and longn[0] = 1 for the current test case. RESULT longm_longn_initial_values]
            [COMMAND For each i from 1 to s-1 inclusive, compute longm[i]: if M[i] equals M[i-1], set longm[i] = longm[i-1] + 1; otherwise set longm[i] = 2, set j = i-2, and while j >= 0 and (M[j] == M[i] or N[j] == N[i-1]), increment longm[i] and decrement j. RESULT longm_array]
            [COMMAND For each i from 1 to s-1 inclusive, compute longn[i]: if N[i] equals N[i-1], set longn[i] = longn[i-1] + 1; otherwise set longn[i] = 2, set j = i-2, and while j >= 0 and (N[j] == N[i] or M[j] == M[i-1]), increment longn[i] and decrement j. RESULT longn_array]
            [COMMAND Initialize max to getmax(longm[0], longn[0]) and max_no to 1. RESULT max_max_no_initial]
            [COMMAND For each i from 1 to s-1 inclusive, compute candidate = getmax(longm[i], longn[i]); if candidate > max, set max = candidate and max_no = 1; else if candidate == max, increment max_no. RESULT max_max_no_final]
            [COMMAND After completing the inner computations, print using printf with the format "Case #%d: %d %d\n" and arguments test, max, max_no. RESULT stdout_output]
            [COMMAND Return 0 from main after all test cases are processed. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
